behavior: Check is default. Explicit --apply stages only the versioned v29 kernel package, matching PVR and initrd; no default selection or reboot.
Never changes bootcmd/SPL/GPT, raw media, default kernel aliases or default DTB. Protects every existing noncandidate /boot entry, generic root symlinks and v16/v27/v28 release trees/package state.
Fixed known v16/v27/v28 boot files, DTBs and PVRs checked before installation; final protected snapshots compared byte-for-byte.
Private mount namespace suppresses /etc/kernel, /usr/share/kernel, /etc/initramfs/post-update.d and /etc/initramfs-tools/post-update.d hooks.
Complete package/control/payload/Image/PVR bindings fixed by independent read-only audit. Maintainer scripts identical to reviewed v28 except release string.

Package config must be a regular file with exactly one enabled ADVISE_SYSCALLS assignment during inputs() before installation, and again in final_check(). Missing/disabled/conflicting/duplicate settings or config symlinks are refused.
Only semantic config changes are ADVISE_SYSCALLS=y and LOCALVERSION=v29. Newly visible ANON_VMA_NAME disabled comment does not enable that feature; both generated autoconf headers keep it absent.
Writer process groups must stop before rollback. Saved bounded protected roots recover missing files; symlink parent/leaf handling preserved from reviewed v28 updater.
Unbound check/apply/rollback entry points all stop before board access. Successful apply reports STAGED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_BOOT_TESTED.

review_repairs: Moved the essential ADVISE config check into inputs() so --check itself refuses unsuitable fixed artifacts. Kept final verification using the same exact-setting validator.
limits: No board staging, reboot, native madvise/SHM test or 1080p60 acceptance performed by these reviewers.
Host rollback tests use temporary filesystem state and simulate root journal ownership. Board identity, filesystem and private mount checks remain runtime gates.
Failure can retain versioned candidate files for diagnosis; this updater does not uninstall or select them.
